source_row.extraction_instructions: Nuxt SPA; ?page=N is ignored server-side. list_shells_override loads the calendar in the browser, captures the site's own public GraphQL Authorization header, then pages entries (16/page, offset) from cms.uroweb.org/graphql until entryCount; live upcoming events only (on-demand excluded). Detail pages are server-rendered: .lead description, .event-details table (Organiser, CME, Venue, Location 'City, Country'). Fees appear on 13 pages as rich-text tables (Category | EAU Member | Non-EAU Member, or a single member/non-member row) parsed by a bespoke EUR parser; other pages have none. Hotel room rates in prose are ignored. Specialty is always Urology.

concerns: Recon volume estimate of ~700 was the sitemap (includes past + on-demand). The calendar's own entryCount is 55 upcoming live events; all 55 fetched, unique, matching. Two runs identical.
On-demand education (/education-events/education, separate Craft entry type) is deliberately excluded; revisit if wanted via is_on_demand.

Listing depends on capturing the site's public GraphQL bearer token from a browser request and on the Craft query shape; a site redesign could break it. After 3 failed tries it logs an error and returns [] (no silent partial listing).
Multi-day courses like Robotic Urology Course show a single date in the site's dateRange even when the text says two days; extractor follows the site's date.
Some pages have no description (e.g. Eger ESU course); description is then None. Site-wide boilerplate meta description is deliberately rejected.
Region holds the country from 'City, Country'; shell city is used when the page has no Location row (region None then).
Fee tables on 13 of 54 pages parsed to EUR tiers (labels 'Registration · <Category> · EAU Member/Non-EAU Member'); other pages publish no fee. booking_url remains the uroweb page.

Description is scoped to event content sections (excludes metadata table, organiser contact, share bar, nav/footer) and rejects chrome phrases; 12 pages have no description text at all and return None.
